rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: All four canonical F-host recovery/output receipts remain mandatory before final-ready.
rule_descriptions.CONTINUATION_KEY_GATE: Preserve the existing continuation key and task/attempt identity.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: Do not create a second runner or task while guarded recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source IDs remain unique and contiguous.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain unique and contiguous.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs remain unique and contiguous within the current repaired range.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Unknown or unavailable evidence must never become numeric zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing three measured parcel values remain unchanged during QA-only increments.
rule_descriptions.EA_DSM1M_EXCLUDE: EA DSM1m includes objects and is excluded from bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_DSM2M_EXCLUDE: EA DSM2m includes objects and is excluded from bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_FZDSM2M_EXCLUDE: EA first-return DSM2m is object-inclusive and excluded from bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_RETIRED_25CM: Retired 25cm composite must not be selected as a current production source.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Parcel-specific survey identity remains unknown until exact metadata-index feature match.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY: EA DTM1m remains the primary bare-earth terrain source.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_TECH_ROLE: Terrain50 is a coarse secondary DTM cross-check only.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_SUPPLY_REFRESH: Annual July resupply is product freshness, not observation time.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_PIXEL_CENTRE: Terrain50 grid values are pixel-centre derived values.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_METADATA: Terrain50 per-tile metadata is lineage support, not EA survey identity.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_CORRELATED_FORMATS: Grid and contour formats from same source are correlated evidence.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_SPOT_ROUNDING: Terrain50 spot heights rounded to integer metres cannot replace finer primary samples.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_SCHEMA_ROLE: Schema conformance is structure validation, not accuracy evidence.
rule_descriptions.FORMAT_CONVERSION_PRESERVE: Format conversion must preserve CRS, vertical reference and numeric values.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96 percent is repository workflow confidence, not a universal statistical interval.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: No business rows while recovery acceptance is incomplete.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready stays false while canonical recovery receipts are absent.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repository overlay is line-by-line visibility, not port-8012 acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Do not rewrite shared main manifest during concurrent slot publishing.
